notes: ⚠️ THE EDITOR WAS SHOWING TWO SCREENS AT ONCE. Open it on a Mini Widget and the hidden Visuals pane — Meters, Gauges, Graphs — appeared beside whichever screen you were actually on, squeezing Position into half the window. Fixed.

The cause: one line set that pane's visibility while wiring up, and it runs AFTER the screen has been chosen, so it un-hid a pane the navigation had already put away. It was a race, which is why it did not happen on every open and did not…

Only the code that switches screens may show a screen now. The Visuals and Graphics panes have no navigation button, so neither can be the screen you are on, and both stay put away until something puts a button back.
